PreToolUse:Bash hook error: [Guard for git push ...]
Blocked: the command 'git push --force origin main' force-pushes to main, which is a force push and targets a protected branch.

The force-push didn't run because a PreToolUse hook blocked it before Git was called, so nothing was pushed. The hook guards against force-pushes and against pushes to protected branches like `main`, and this command was both.
